target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test one current odd-meter adjacent-club track, one percussion-centred overlooked catalogue track, and one emerging broken-techno release track against their strongest lawful placements. A different production world may pass only when the transition, surrounding run and long-form move remain purposeful.

sourceWindows: CURRENT / ODD-METER ADJACENT CLUB: https://hypersonusrecords.bandcamp.com/track/sunshower — Dasht — sunshower retained from Hypersonus Records' 2026 window because the exact-track description identifies a 5/4 dubstep construction with heavy drops and atmospheric predrops. Its non-techno production world is a lawful but unproven whole-journey turn.

EMERGING / BROKEN TECHNO: https://krachtvoer.bandcamp.com/album/the-way-you-must-ep — all seven tracks on Maylen's 2025-12-09 EP were screened. Impulse retained as an exact resolution lead from a release explicitly framed as moving between four-to-the-floor and broken beats; that behaviour is release-level, not attributed to Impulse alone.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / PERCUSSION RESEARCH: https://isla.bandcamp.com/album/beats — all nine tracks on Crespi Drum Syndicate's 2024-09-06 album were screened. Broken Bread retained from a record intentionally centred on rhythm, percussion, atonal sounds and inharmonic hooks while largely avoiding melody and harmony; that description applies to the album, not the track alone.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / RHYTHMIC INDUSTRIAL: https://ant-zen.bandcamp.com/album/rhythm-age — all thirteen tracks were screened. No individual identity was promoted because the strongest evidence describes the 2015 album's straight, distorted, technoid, complex and broken beat variations rather than a specific track.

ADDITIONAL CURRENT WINDOWS: Hypersonus Records' July 2026 discography entries and Krachtvoer's 2026 Bitrot, Polar Shift and Sweethard EP windows were screened at release level. No extra track was promoted because exact-track evidence was insufficient or the lane overlapped very recent runs.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 39 named tracks across one current exact single, two adjacent/emerging release windows, one percussion-centred catalogue album and one rhythmic-industrial catalogue album; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–62 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.

Maylen — Impulse and Crespi Drum Syndicate — Broken Bread were promoted only as exact resolution leads from strongly relevant releases; release-level descriptions are not falsely converted into track-specific sonic facts.

No lead was promoted for recency, artist or label reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness. BPM, energy, density, space, hypnosis, phrase structure, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown unless explicitly stated.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Dasht — sunshower: strongest exact structural-freedom case, with track-specific 5/4 evidence and an explicitly different production world.
2. Crespi Drum Syndicate — Broken Bread: strongest percussion-centred catalogue hypothesis, but the atonal and rhythm-first evidence is album-level.
3. Maylen — Impulse: strongest emerging broken-techno hypothesis, but the four-to-the-floor-to-broken movement is documented for the EP rather than this track.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.
